tasks.label: build the extension
tasks.command: cargo build && mkdir -p editors/vscode/server && cp target/debug/ya-lsp editors/vscode/server/ya-lsp && cd editors/vscode && yarn install --frozen-lockfile && yarn bundle

tasks.label: build the extension (release)
tasks.command: cargo build --release && cd editors/vscode && yarn install --frozen-lockfile && yarn bundle
